title: Removable Media Security Incident
briefing: A removable USB drive has been discovered connected to a workstation in a restricted environment. The security team must determine whether the device was used for legitimate purposes or if it represents a potential data exfiltration or malware risk.

injects.title: Endpoint Alert
injects.message: Endpoint protection tools report that the USB device attempted to execute an unknown binary when inserted.

injects.title: Unverified Device Activity
injects.message: Security monitoring shows the device accessed multiple directories before being disconnected.

injects.title: Management Inquiry
injects.message: Management asks whether removable media policies were followed and whether additional systems may be at risk.

injects.title: Policy Compliance Concern
injects.message: Security governance staff note that removable media usage logs appear incomplete for the affected workstation.

step_1.situation: A USB drive is discovered attached to a workstation in a restricted network environment. The security team must identify the key indicators that suggest whether the device poses a security risk.

if_correct.consequence: The team identifies the most relevant indicators and begins investigating the device’s origin and activity.

if_incorrect.consequence: Important warning signs are overlooked, increasing uncertainty about the device's purpose.

step_2.situation: The team reviews endpoint protections and device control policies to determine whether unauthorized media should have been blocked.

if_correct.consequence: Security policies and endpoint controls are reviewed, helping determine whether policy violations occurred.

if_incorrect.consequence: Failure to evaluate device control mechanisms leaves uncertainty about enforcement gaps.

step_3.situation: Management asks whether the USB device should be treated as a security incident requiring escalation or simply a policy violation.

if_correct.consequence: A structured response clarifies risk while preserving investigative flexibility.

if_incorrect.consequence: Unclear guidance creates confusion between security and operational teams.

step_4.situation: The team evaluates whether stronger endpoint protections and device restrictions could prevent similar incidents in the future.

if_correct.consequence: Improved device controls and monitoring reduce the likelihood of future removable media incidents.

if_incorrect.consequence: Failure to strengthen endpoint controls increases the risk of repeated device-related security issues.

step_5.situation: Security considers how to communicate the findings internally and reinforce removable media policy awareness.

if_correct.consequence: Clear internal communication strengthens policy adherence and reinforces security culture.

if_incorrect.consequence: Poor communication weakens policy awareness and leaves uncertainty about proper device usage.
